theorems.name: Submission.doragm_rfv_trace_radial_field
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (y x : Euclid P) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (τ : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → (∀ u, u ≤ 1 → φ u = 1) → 0 < τ → LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (Q.starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ (fun z : Euclid P => φ (‖z - y‖ / τ) • (z - y)) x).toLinearMap) = (Module.finrank ℝ Q : ℝ) * φ (‖x - y‖ / τ) + ‖x - y‖ / τ * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / τ) * (1 - ‖(x - y) - Q.starProjection (x - y)‖ ^ 2 / ‖x - y‖ ^ 2)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
